sn44.11:1.1: Ekam samayam āyasmā Sabhiyo Kaccāno Ñātike viharati Giñjakāvasathe || || 2
sn44.11:1.2: Atha kho Vacchagotto paribbājako yenāyasmā Sabhiyo Kaccāno tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sabhiyena Kaccānena saddhiṃ sammodi ||
sn44.11:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Vacchagotto paribbājako āyasmantaṃ Sabhiyam Kaccānam etad avoca ||
sn44.11:1.4: Kiṃ nu kho bho Kaccāna hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.11:1.7: Kim pana bho Kaccāna na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.11:1.8: Etam pi kho Vaccha avyākatam Bhagavatā.
sn44.11:1.9: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 5
sn44.11:2.1: Kiṃ nu kho bho Kaccāna hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti ||
sn44.11:2.3: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 6
sn44.11:2.4: Kim pana bho Kaccāna neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.11:2.5: Etam pi kho Vaccha avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.11:2.6: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 7
sn44.11:3.1: Kiṃ nu kho bho Kaccāna Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.3: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vadesi || || 8
sn44.11:3.4: Kim pana bho Kaccāna Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.6: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vadesi || 9
sn44.11:3.7: Kim nu kho bho Kaccāna Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.9: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vadesi || || 10
sn44.11:3.10: Kim pana bho Kaccāna Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti iti puṭṭho samāno
sn44.11:3.11: Etam pi kho vaccha avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.11:3.12: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vadesi || || 11
sn44.11:3.13: Ko nu kho bho Kaccāna hetu ko paccayo yena tam avyākataṃ samaṇena Gotamenā ti || || 12
sn44.11:3.14: Yo ca Vaccha hetu yo ca paccayo paññāpanāya Rūpīti vā Arūpīti vā Saññīti vā Asaññīti vā Neva saññī nāsaññīti vā || so ca hetu so ca paccayo sabbena sabbaṃ sabbathā sabbam aparisesaṃ nirujjheyya ||
sn44.11:3.15: kena naṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya Rūpīti vā Arūpīti vā Saññī vā Asaññīti va Neva saññī nāsaññīti vā ti || || 13
sn44.11:3.16: Kīva ciram pabbajito si Kaccānā ti || ||
sn44.11:3.17: Na ciram āvuso tīni vassānī ti || || 14
sn44.11:3.18: Yassa passa āvuso ettakena ettakam eva tam passa bahuṃ || ko pana vādo eva abhikkante ti || ||
sn44.11:5.5: Avyākatan ti dasadhā ti || || Dasabalaselappabhavā nibbānamahāsamuddapariyantā
